entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... V F 8 8 1 2 9 0.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now. I see the order for the Aero-X Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the color. It looked different online. The box is still unopened, so it's brand new.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 36 days ago.
Okay, one moment while I check our policy. ... Yes, according to our system, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So we can definitely get that processed for you.

Excellent. We always want to ensure our customers are completely satisfied, both with the fit and the style. Your safety is our priority, but we know looking good matters too. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Great. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
